tour.title: Workspace Overview
tour.description: README.md introduces the local device-testing workspace and explains its Android interaction, project intake, logs, crash capture, bug tracking, exports, and cloud iOS lane. It distinguishes the local Node server from the external simulator workflow.

tour.title: Server Composition
tour.description: server.js creates the Express app and WebSocket endpoint, serves the browser UI, initializes runtime data directories, and connects Android, project, and bug modules. This is the composition point for the local workflow.

tour.title: Browser Controls
tour.description: The browser code renders device frames, sends touch and key input, follows log/build events, manages project and bug views, and exposes the iOS lane. It communicates with the local API and WebSocket route.

tour.title: Android Bridge
tour.description: The Android module wraps adb and emulator commands for device discovery, screen capture, input, APK install/launch, and logcat. Server-side WebSocket handling uses this bridge to stream the device and forward controls.

tour.title: Project Intake
tour.description: The project module classifies local/mobile project shapes, clones repositories or receives APKs, runs available build commands, locates APK outputs, then installs and launches them through the Android bridge. Runtime clones live under the ignored workspace directory.

tour.title: Bug Evidence
tour.description: The bug module persists structured reports as JSON, stores screenshots, captures log and device context supplied by the server, and exports Markdown, CSV, JSON, or ZIP artifacts. Runtime data is ignored and is not part of this graph.

tour.title: Probe Application
tour.description: The included Android probe app provides basic interaction and a deliberate crash path for a local smoke workflow. Its script and WebSocket helper support rebuilding or exercising the prototype, but no such run was performed for this graph task.

tour.title: Contributor Workflow
tour.description: CONTRIBUTING.md records setup expectations and the manual AVD smoke workflow for changes to Android integration. Use it alongside the README before extending this deliberately small prototype.
